description: This file defines the Attribute class used for collecting, sanitizing, and rendering HTML attributes within the Drupal core templating system. It manages attribute data, supports array-like syntax, and provides methods for attribute manipulation and rendering.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: A class for managing HTML attributes, supporting array access, merging, and rendering, used within Drupal's templating system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Attribute object with an optional array of attributes.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an attribute by name, initializing 'class' as an empty array if not set.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets the value of an attribute, converting it into an appropriate AttributeValueBase subclass.

methods.name: createAttributeValue
methods.description: Creates an AttributeValueBase object based on the attribute's value and name.

methods.name: offsetUnset
methods.description: Removes an attribute by name.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if an attribute exists.

methods.name: addClass
methods.description: Adds one or more CSS classes to the 'class' attribute.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets a specific attribute's value.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a specific attribute exists.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes one or more attributes.

methods.name: removeClass
methods.description: Removes one or more CSS classes from the 'class' attribute.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Returns the 'class' attribute value.

methods.name: hasClass
methods.description: Checks if a specific CSS class exists within the 'class' attribute.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Renders all attributes as a string suitable for HTML output.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all attributes as an associative array.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Clones the Attribute object, deep copying attribute values.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the attribute storage.

methods.name: storage
methods.description: Returns the internal storage array of attributes.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Provides a JSON-serializable representation of the attributes.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another Attribute object into this one.
